## Problem

What user problem would this solve?

## Proposed behavior

What should OCBox do differently?

## Why OCBox?

Why does this belong in OCBox instead of Docker Sandboxes, OpenCode, llama.cpp, or project-specific tooling?

## Security / trust-boundary impact

Could this expose new host files, credentials, network destinations, Docker capabilities, writable mounts, or automatic execution paths?

## Regression-test idea

If this changes a security or handoff invariant, how could OCBox test it automatically?
